messages:
Hannah P.: Customer (Neptune Labs, CUST-10234) pinged — says they received a $250 charge for "priority-support" that should have been waived under their promo. Invoice INV-2026-0520. Can billing check and issue credit if valid?
Sophie (Billing): Pulling invoice now. I see a promo code APR_SUPPORT_WAIVE applied but also a separate paid line for priority-support $250. Looks like promo didn't flag that SKU.
Corey (CS): Customer insists promo included support. They sent the signed promo terms. Tagging docs: https://support.redwood/promos/APR_SUPPORT_WAIVE.pdf
Sophie (Billing): We can do a manual adjustment credit memo for $250 to correct. Prefer account credit. Need approval from finance lead. Also recommend updating promo rules to include support SKU.
finance-bot: Approval request sent to finance-leads channel for CM-2026-1167.
Liam R.: Approved. Issue $250 goodwill/manual adjustment. Memo: "Promo not applied to support SKU 52 INV-2026-0520". Cap note: credits under $1k can be handled by billing.
Sophie (Billing): Posted CM-2026-1167, GL 6302, account credit applied. Audit link: https://audit.redwood/cm/CM-2026-1167. Notified customer and CC'd CS.
Hannah P.: Customer confirmed credit applied and appreciated quick turnaround. I'll follow up with product on promo rule fix. Thread resolved from finance side. :white_check_mark:
